title: PhotoDeg-Bench v1.0.0: an open, harmonized benchmark of visible-light polymer deconstruction conditions and outcomes
description:
Source-verified records of visible-light photochemical polymer deconstruction experiments from the open-access literature (Europe PMC, OpenAlex): polymer, molar mass before and after, SEC calibration, catalyst, wavelength, solvent, time and product yields, with harmonization rules and comparability tiers.

Curation method: records were screened, extracted and harmonized by an AI system (Claude) under the author's delegation. Every value carries its locator and source string and was checked by a deterministic source-matching script, and every record was independently re-extracted blind, with disagreements adjudicated against the source and logged. No human expert reviewed individual records for this version.

Contents: benchmark table (CSV), evidence log, screening log, verification audit trail, rules, QA report, exceptions, code, documentation. Main limitation: about three quarters of in-scope papers had no retrievable full text; see LIMITATIONS.md.
notes: AI assistance: curation and code by Claude (Anthropic) under author delegation; see docs/METHODS_AUTOMATED_CURATION.md.
